name: Harness Engineering
tagline: An anthology and field guide to agent harness engineering
description: Harness Engineering is an anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle focused on the craft of building agent harnesses. Written in Python, it collects practical knowledge for designing and operating the scaffolding that drives AI agents. The bundle doubles as agent context, letting new agents onboard into harness-engineering conventions directly.
highlights: Anthology and field guide for agent harness engineering
Ships as an agent context bundle for easy onboarding
Practical, design-oriented reference for harness builders
curatorNote: Harness design is underserved as a discipline — this field guide plus agent context bundle is a rare, practical resource for builders structuring agent scaffolding.
